title: 剪纸层叠
description: 剪纸不止一种。一支 24 秒博览：民俗红纸镂空、几何色块层叠、立体景深纸板、单色剪影、水彩纸毛边、字体剪纸，用撕揭折剪交棒；几何层叠落进天气 App。片尾开场窗花收成一点再砸成红纸印章，三句改成门笺挖空。

images.titleEn: Four steps from a flat fill to Paper Cut

descriptionEn: Paper cut is more than one look. A 24-second expo of six named variants — folk red cutouts, color-block strata, cardboard diorama, monochrome silhouette, deckle-edge wash, and type cut from stacked sheets — handed off with tear, peel, fold, and snip. The ending spins the opening window flower down to a point and slams it as a red paper seal.
